sents.zh: 宋朝的城里有很多喝茶的地方。
sents.en: Song cities had many places to drink tea.

sents.zh: 这些地方一早就开门了。
sents.en: They opened early in the morning.

sents.zh: 因为很多人上午就来了。
sents.en: Because many people came in the morning.

sents.zh: 有的人来喝茶，有的人来见朋友。
sents.en: Some came for tea, some to meet friends.

sents.zh: 商人在这里说买卖的事情。
他们一边喝，一边说要买什么、卖什么。
sents.en: They drank and discussed what to buy and sell.

sents.zh: 老人在这里说很久以前的事。
sents.en: Old people talked there about times long past.

sents.zh: 小孩子也来，坐在后面听。
sents.en: Children came too, and sat at the back listening.

sents.zh: 下午的时候，会有人来说故事。
sents.en: In the afternoon someone would come to tell stories.

sents.zh: 他说得非常好，大家都不说话了。
sents.en: He told them so well that everyone fell silent.

sents.zh: 故事里有大王，有兵，也有龙。
sents.en: In the stories were kings, soldiers and dragons.

sents.zh: 一个故事要说好几天才说完。
sents.en: One story took several days to finish.

sents.zh: 所以第二天，大家还会再来。
sents.en: So the next day everyone came back.

sents.zh: 喝茶的地方也是听新事情的地方。
sents.en: The teahouse was also where you heard the news.

sents.zh: 今天在中国，还可以找到这样的地方。
sents.en: In China today you can still find such places.
